ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_EksportCenyTowarow' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_EksportCenyTowarow;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportCenyTowarow] @rowVersion bigint, @PointOfSaleId int AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
declare @Cenniki table(id int, PriceListId int, ProductId int,GrossPrice decimal(15,4),NetPrice decimal(15,4),CurrencyId int,UnitId int,Points int,ValidityStartDate datetime,PriceTypeId int,LastMod int)
insert into @cenniki select distinct twc_id as [@Id], tcn_id as [@PriceListId], TwC_TwrNumer as [@ProductId], CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(naz_nazwa,11,1) = 'B' THEN Twc_Wartosc else ROUND(TwC_Wartosc * (1 + (TwrStawkaPodSpr / 100)), ( select case when TwC_Zaok=0.1 then 1 when TwC_Zaok=0.01 then 2 when TwC_Zaok=0.001 then 3 else 4 end)) + TwC_Offset end as [@GrossPrice], CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(naz_nazwa,11,1) = 'B' THEN ROUND(Twc_Wartosc / (1 + (TwrStawkaPodSpr / 100)), ( select case when TwC_Zaok=0.1 then 1 when TwC_Zaok=0.01 then 2 when TwC_Zaok=0.001 then 3 else 4 end)) + TwC_Offset ELSE TwC_Wartosc end as [@NetPrice], WaNid as [@CurrencyId], (select naz_gidlp from cdn.Nazwy where Naz_Nazwa = Twr_Jm AND naz_gidtyp=144) as [@UnitId], 0 as [@Points], -- as [@SetElementId] NULL DATEADD(second,TwC_DataOd,convert(datetime,'01-01-1990',105)) as [@ValidityStartDate], -- as [@ValidityEndDate] NULL -- as [@AcceptanceDate] NULL TCN_RodzajCeny as [@PriceTypeId], TwC_CzasModyfikacji FROM CDN.POS_TwrDoEksportu(@PointOfSaleId,0) join cdn.TwrKarty on Twr_GIDNumer=twrgidnumer join cdn.TwrCeny on TwC_TwrNumer = TwrGIDNumer join cdn.TwrCenyNag on TwC_TcnId = TCN_Id join cdn.Pos_WanDoEksportu(@PointOfSaleId,0) on TwC_Waluta = WanSymbol join cdn.POS_TCNDoEksportu(@PointOfSaleId) on CenaLP = TCN_RodzajCeny join cdn.nazwy on Naz_GIDTyp = 64 and Naz_GIDLp = CenaLP where tcn_stan = 5
SELECT isnull((select max(c1.LastMod) from @Cenniki c1 where LastMod > @RowVersion),@rowVersion) AS [@RowVersion] ,( select Id as [@Id], PriceListId as [@PriceListId], ProductId as [@ProductId], GrossPrice as [@GrossPrice], NetPrice as [@NetPrice], CurrencyId as [@CurrencyId], UnitId as [@UnitId], Points as [@Points], ValidityStartDate as [@ValidityStartDate] from @Cenniki c1 where LastMod > @RowVersion OR (@RowVersion = 0) for xml path('ProductPrice'), type) for xml path('ProductPrices') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportCenyTowarow TO CDNRaport
